🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; mixed signals with Healthcare strength offset by Technology weakness. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Healthcare), so style mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: MDT (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +9.96%) ABOVE TREND. Energy showing follow-through: CVX (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +4.64%) ABOVE TREND; XOM (1W: +1.59% | 1M: +4.23%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples showing rotation led by WMT (1W: +4.56% | 1M: -7.79%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -10.59% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.90% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +5.00%) CORRECTION. Communication weak: META (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -5.09%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: AMZN (1W: -6.14% | 1M: -9.57%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: MDT (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND; ASML (1W: +7.40% | 1M: +15.33%) ABOVE TREND; CVS (1W: +7.13% | 1M: +11.13%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +9.96%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership concentration: Narrow (3/5 Healthcare).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: SHOP (1W: -10.75% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND; ACN (1W: -11.27% | 1M: -3.20%) BELOW TREND; PANW (1W: -11.37% | 1M: +35.52%) CORRECTION; IBM (1W: -12.36% | 1M: +22.30%) CORRECTION; CRM (1W: -12.91% | 1M: -2.03%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Technology.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: MDT (1W: +9.07%), AMAT (1W: +7.42%), ASML (1W: +7.40%); watch AMAT/ASML for semiconductor cycle confirmation. Major divergence present (≥3 large names with 1W ≠ 1M such as PANW, IBM, ORCL) — tactical volatility, watch for trend breaks.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak: AMAT (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND and ASML (1W: +7.40% | 1M: +15.33%) ABOVE TREND versus mega-cap dispersion (MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META all BELOW TREND); AAPL in CORRECTION. Sector breadth: Technology (24 stocks) — Sector Weakness.

8. Financials Outlook?
Internal rotation: JPM (1W: +4.90% | 1M: +1.58%) ABOVE TREND and PNC (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +3.58%) ABOVE TREND, but Visa (1W: -0.96% | 1M: -0.29%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Financials (20 stocks) — Internal Rotation.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Clear leadership within the market: MDT (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +18.07%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +9.96%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +3.87% | 1M: +4.94%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare (17 stocks) — Internal Rotation with multiple confirmed leaders.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Healthcare exposure and selective cyclicals (JPM, CAT, CAT (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +2.23%) ABOVE TREND) given narrow leadership; reduce exposure to high-multiple Technology names showing below-trend price action. Monitor major divergence in tech for tactical entries rather than core reweights.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: LLY (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +18.07%) ABOVE TREND (FDA nod + strong price confirmation); AMAT (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND (cycle play). BEARISH: MSFT (1W: -10.59% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND (follow-through risk), NVDA (1W: -6.90% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND (watch for further distribution).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (Breadth positive; multiple leaders ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Technology (significant mega-cap weakness) and Communication (weak 1W performance).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA: failure to reclaim recent 1W range would reinforce BELOW TREND continuation; AAPL: hold above recent 1M support to avoid deeper CORRECTION; JPM/PNC: sustain 1W breakout to confirm financial leadership; MDT/LLY: sustain above-trend moves to validate sector rotation.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+80): FDA nod for EBGLYSS; price ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. MDT (+60): FDA nod for pulse oximetry; price ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. SHOP (+80): Buyback/AI narrative; SHOP (1W: -10.75% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines but price diverging (distribution), watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
V (-40): Merchant settlement headline; V (1W: -0.96% | 1M: -0.29%) BELOW TREND — news aligns with price pressure. LLY (-40): Novo Wegovy adoption note appears alongside LLY (+80) FDA news; LLY (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +18.07%) ABOVE TREND — conflicting sentiment, monitor for headline-driven volatility.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with mixed signals and narrow leadership; style mixed / no clear leadership. Healthcare names showing relative strength — MDT ABOVE TREND, UNH ABOVE TREND, LLY ABOVE TREND. Key risk: major divergence in Technology (multiple mega-caps BELOW TREND) and conflicting news on LLY/SHOP that could amplify short-term volatility.
